'''Bracco''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who threatened [[Syreena]] after [[Rogun Matt'rik]] posted a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Viidu]] after [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] stole Rogun's shipment of blasters. The [[Voidhound|smuggler]] who delivered the shipment [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] bluffed that Rogun the Butcher wanted Syreena alive, prompting Bracco and his men to leave.

He was often seen armed with two [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[SSK heavy blaster]]s.
